crossRefs.note: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.
If you take your neighbor’s garment as collateral, you shall restore it to him before the sun goes down,
for that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin. What would he sleep in? It will happen, when he cries to…
Now a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets cried out to Elisha, saying, “Your servant my husband is…

translations.web: If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?
translations.bsb: If you have nothing with which to pay, why should your bed be taken from under you?
translations.kjv: If thou hast nothing to pay, why should he take away thy bed
translations.asv: If thou hast not wherewith to pay, Why should he take away thy bed from under thee?
